headline: OKX Bitcoin Spot Buy Delta Falls To 128.8 Bitcoin From 273.7 As The 30-Day Rank Drops To 64.9
narrative: OKX spot bitcoin taker delta fell to 128.8 bitcoin over the last 24 hours from 273.7 bitcoin, and the rank of that window against the last 30 days dropped to 64.9 from 81.0. The pipe subtracts aggressive sell volume from aggressive buy volume on OKX spot only, so it shows who is lifting the offer rather than a cross-venue tape or passive fills. A rank of 81.0 read buy-side leaning, and a rank of 64.9 reads balanced, so net taker demand is no longer leading that spot book.
